title: Professor Vellum's Workshop for Unfinished Suns
theme: Abandoned arcane laboratory full of unstable light, constructs, and unpaid assistants
hook: A second sunrise flickers every night above the old academy hill. The faculty wants the workshop shut down before the false dawn becomes permanent and burns the district awake.
background: Professor Vellum tried to bottle a harmless training sun for apprentices. The project failed when an assistant trapped a living spark in the engine and hid the shutdown phrase in the lab notes.

layout.notes: Workshop floorplan with mechanical rooms, ritual work zones, and controlled branch routes.

rooms.name: Reception of Warm Brass
rooms.readAloud: Polished brass walls radiate uncomfortable warmth. A reception desk ticks through appointment cards no one will keep.
rooms.gmNotes: The appointment cards list names of assistants, including one crossed out as "inside the sun."

inhabitants.name: Reception Automaton
inhabitants.tactics: Block unregistered visitors, stamp hands, call security bells
inhabitants.morale: Allows entry with a plausible appointment
inhabitants.leverage: Accepts forged or recovered appointment cards

rooms.treasure: A brass visitor badge that opens minor lab doors.
rooms.secrets: The crossed-out assistant name is the shutdown phrase's first word.
rooms.exits: Door to Room 2, service panel to Room 4.

rooms.name: Lens Hall
rooms.readAloud: Huge lenses hang on rails, turning stray light into bright bars across the floor.
rooms.gmNotes: Moving lenses can create safe shadows or burn through a jammed door.
rooms.treasure: A focusing crystal in a cracked lens mount.
rooms.secrets: A shadowed alcove hides an assistant's apology note.
rooms.exits: Back to Room 1, bright door to Room 3, shadow stair to Room 5.

rooms.name: Construct Assembly Bay
rooms.readAloud: Half-built brass bodies hang from hooks. Several turn their eyeless heads as the party enters.
rooms.gmNotes: The constructs defend the lab but can be reassigned with visitor badges and confident commands.

inhabitants.name: Unfinished Brass Constructs
inhabitants.tactics: Hold corridors, interpose bodies, obey literal orders
inhabitants.morale: Power down if given a valid maintenance command
inhabitants.leverage: Badges and clear command phrasing override aggression

rooms.treasure: A compact gear-heart useful to academy engineers.
rooms.secrets: One construct contains the shutdown phrase's second word.
rooms.exits: Bright door to Room 2, lift to Room 6.

rooms.name: Assistant Dormitory
rooms.readAloud: Cots, chalkboards, and cold tea crowd the cramped room. Someone has written "do not trust dawn" on the ceiling.
rooms.gmNotes: An unpaid assistant has been hiding here and wants both rescue and overdue wages.

inhabitants.name: Exhausted Lab Assistant
inhabitants.tactics: Hide behind chalkboards, bargain with notes, avoid blame
inhabitants.morale: Cooperates if promised credit and payment
inhabitants.wants: The spark freed and their name restored
inhabitants.leverage: Knows Vellum feared the engine's third bell

rooms.treasure: Annotated notes and a drawer of unpaid wage chits.
rooms.secrets: The assistant crossed out the final shutdown word to hide it from Vellum.
rooms.exits: Service panel to Room 1, chalk tunnel to Room 5.

rooms.name: Prism Conservatory
rooms.readAloud: Plants made of glass leaves turn toward a floating bead of sunlight. Shadows here move half a breath late.
rooms.gmNotes: The glass plants can be coaxed to form a bridge, but harsh light makes them lash out.

inhabitants.name: Prism Vines
inhabitants.tactics: Snare bright objects, recoil from calm shade

rooms.treasure: A glass seed that glows gently for a week.
rooms.secrets: The delayed shadows spell the shutdown phrase when the lenses are aligned.
rooms.exits: Shadow stair to Room 2, chalk tunnel to Room 4, iris door to Room 6.

rooms.name: The Unfinished Sun Engine
rooms.readAloud: A miniature sun turns inside a cage of black iron. Its light throws the party's shadows into impossible shapes.
rooms.gmNotes: The living spark is frightened, not evil. It can be freed, stabilized, or sealed by using the full phrase.

inhabitants.name: Living Dawn Spark
inhabitants.tactics: Blind intruders, animate tools, beg through heat shimmer
inhabitants.morale: Stops lashing out if promised release or safe housing
inhabitants.wants: Not to be trapped as a teaching aid
inhabitants.leverage: Responds to honesty and the assistant's name

rooms.treasure: A stabilized sun-drop, academy reward, and proof of Vellum's misconduct.
rooms.secrets: Vellum knew the spark was alive and continued the experiment.
rooms.exits: Lift to Room 3, iris door to Room 5, emergency hatch to the academy roof.

gmNotes: This is the best stress test for long hooks and dense room detail.
The assistant is the social path through the laboratory.
The twist is that the spark is alive and Vellum knew it.
A good ending prevents the false dawn and decides the spark's future.
